synopsis: Google Cloud G2 is presented as a generic GPU cloud execution option using NVIDIA L4 data-center GPUs, consistent with the glossary’s hardware mapping [f8370, f16202]. Chapter 11 describes it as pay-per-use and lists a 2026 public price of USD 1.734 per hour for g2-standard-32 [f9259, f9260]. The table marks its off-road relevance as not applicable, so its inclusion as a compute option does not establish off-road-specific suitability [f8370, f9259].
